name: AdminGrant
description: Private server-maintained administrator grant and revocation record for a platform account

user_id.description: Stable platform user id receiving the administrator grant

user_email.description: Normalized account email retained for display and legacy fallback

role.description: Effective role represented by this record, currently administrator

granted_at.description: ISO timestamp when administrator access was granted

granted_by.description: Normalized email of the administrator who granted access

revoked_at.description: ISO timestamp when administrator access was revoked

revoked_by.description: Normalized email of the administrator who revoked access

note.description: Bounded private reason for the grant or revocation
